description.value: Gulraj Farm is a family-operated blueberry farm in Tsawwassen run by Bainsdavinder and Nirlep. As a direct-sales farm shop, it offers cyclists on the South Delta route a chance to pick up fresh local blueberries close to the Tsawwassen ferry terminal area. Farm stands like this are classic touring stops for fresh, locally grown produce.
